column6: SURPASS-T1D-1 (NCT06914895, about 905 adults, four tirzepatide doses against placebo, primary completion estimated 2026-11) and SURPASS-T1D-2 (NCT06962280, about 465 adults, long-term, primary completion estimated 2026-11) are Lilly Phase 3 studies in adults with type 1 diabetes on insulin for at least a year, HbA1c 7.0% to 10.5% and BMI of 25 kg/m2 or more, each with one primary outcome, change from baseline in HbA1c at Week 40 (ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, read 2026-11-16). Obesity is an entry criterion and glycaemic control is what reads out, so the disease is Diabetes Mellitus, Type 1 (D003922). Neither label covers it: Mounjaro is indicated 'to improve glycemic control in adults and pediatric patients 10 years of age and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus' (DailyMed setid 0818426a-53eb-4db7-9609-bbae1e7a3964, effective 2026-07-29), and Zepbound 'to reduce excess body weight and maintain weight reduction long term in adults with obesity or adults with overweight in the presence of at least one weight-related comorbid condition' and to treat OSA in adults with obesity (setid 487cd7e7-434c-4925-99fa-aa80b1cc776b, version 40, effective 2026-08-28), with no glycaemic claim.
